name: Daily Risk Tips
description: 每日风险提示生成工具：检索 Milvus 中人工审核定稿的历史范例，提炼写作规则后生成一条符合深圳市网信办撰写规范的新风险提示（≤150字）。

timeoutMs.description: Max time to wait for the generation turn before failing the tool.

styleTimeoutMs.description: Max time to wait for the optional retrieval/style-extraction turn. Kept well under the frontend's 90s no-event watchdog; on expiry the tool degrades to the generic style prompt instead of failing.

retrievalCooldownMs.description: After a failed or empty retrieval turn (e.g. Milvus unreachable or the embedding provider is overdue), skip that turn entirely for this long. Set 0 to always attempt retrieval.

sourceCollection.description: Milvus collection holding the human-approved finalized 每日风险提示 examples. Read-only.

embeddingProfile.description: Name of the milvus plugin's embeddingProfiles entry to use for retrieval (must match the embedding model the collection was built with).

topK.description: How many similar finalized examples to retrieve.

queryMaxChars.description: Truncate the retrieval query to this many characters before embedding.
